# dungeon

Den's public API, built on [Gen](https://github.com/sini/gen) libraries only.
Drop-in replacement for `github:denful/den`.

- Same API as Den.
- Same `drvPath`s as Den for the registered flakes below.
- Core is built on Gen, which is proved and tested.

## Progress

Each row of `registry.nix` is a flake whose `drvPath`s we compare: with its own `den` input, and with `den` replaced by dungeon.
Den templates are read from the latest `github:denful/den`.
Den tests (`templates/ci`, run with [fastest](https://github.com/denful/fastest)), by category, increasing complexity. Den passes all of them:

## Try it

Use dungeon in place of Den in your flake:

```
nix eval --override-input den github:vic/dungeon .#nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath
nix build --override-input den github:vic/dungeon .#nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.system.build.toplevel
```

Start from a Den template and override `den`:

```
nix flake init -t github:denful/den#minimal
nix eval --override-input den github:vic/dungeon .#nixosConfigurations.igloo.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath
```

## Contributing

### Add your flake to the registry

1. Fork this repo.
2. Add an entry to `registry.nix`:

   ```nix
   {
     name = "my-flake";
     kind = "flake";
     flake = "github:you/your-repo";   # or "github:you/your-repo?dir=sub"
     attrs = [ "nixosConfigurations.foo" ];   # or "auto": all nixos, darwin and home configurations
     denInput = "den";                 # name of your flake input that points at Den
     owner = "you";
   }
   ```

3. Run `just write` (regenerates `README.md` and the workflows) and commit the result.
4. Open a PR. CI runs your entry as one job of the `den-templates` workflow.

### Compare locally and open an issue

`drvPathDiff` evaluates your flake twice: with its own `den` input, and with `den` overridden to dungeon.
It prints `OK`, `DIFF` or `ERR` per attr.

```
nix run github:vic/dungeon?dir=dev#drvPathDiff -- github:you/your-flake
nix run github:vic/dungeon?dir=dev#drvPathDiff -- --no-auto github:you/your-flake nixosConfigurations.foo
nix run github:vic/dungeon?dir=dev#drvPathDiff -- --dungeon ./path/to/dungeon path:.
```

Flags: `--dungeon REF|DIR` (default `github:vic/dungeon`), `--den REF|DIR` (replace the Den side too), `--input NAME` (default `den`), `--ignore ATTR` (repeatable), `--packages` (also `packages.x86_64-linux`), `--no-auto` (only the attrs given), `--out FILE`.

On any `DIFF` or `ERR` it writes an issue body (flake, Den rev, dungeon rev, attrs, both drvPaths, first error, nix version) and prints the command:

```
gh issue create -R vic/dungeon --title '...' --body-file <file>
```

Exit code is 1 when something differs. Run that command to open the issue.

## Development

```
nix develop ./dev     # just, nix-unit, nixfmt, gh, jq, ripgrep, fd, actionlint, drvPathDiff
just --list
just progress         # gate on all registry entries + test categories deadbugs,c1..c4; writes dev/status.json
just gate [entry...]  # registry entries: den=Den vs den=dungeon, drvPaths equal
just test [category]  # deadbugs|c1|c2|c3|c4 of Den templates/ci on dungeon
just diff <flake>     # drvPathDiff against this checkout
just write           # regenerate README.md and .github/workflows (nix flake check path:.?dir=dev verifies)
just fmt
```


## CI

- `ci.yml`: `nix flake check` (README.md and workflows match their sources).
- `den-templates.yml`: one job per registry entry.
- `tests.yml`: one job per category (deadbugs, c1..c4). All use `continue-on-error` (reporting mode) while dungeon is unstable; the pass counts feed the progress table.

Dev tools live in the `dev/` sub-flake. The top-level flake has one input: `gen`.

Equivalent manual run: `nix run github:denful/fastest -- --flake 'github:denful/den?dir=templates/ci#tests' --override-input den path:$PWD deadbugs`.
